# **​What to Expect**

​​Join us for a special weekend developer experience! We're long time San Diego developers, looking to fostering a community of devs of all skill levels to have fun, network, and learn new things!

## **​​Connect**

​​​For this monthly meetup, we gather for lunch to introduce ourselves and enjoy complimentary food and drinks.

## **​​Inspire**

​​After networking lunch, we start a series of presentations from members of the community to share interesting developer topics.

## **​​Build**

​​​Once presentations are finished, we break into groups to casually network, show off our projects and build together!

# **​​Reminders**

​​Please be courteous and respectful to others.

​​​Laptops are encouraged. Should you be giving a presentation or want to share a project, your laptop is essential. We are developers, let’s build together

​​​Feel free to ask our organizers for help on some code you're struggling with, if you are! We're happy to help where we can.

# **​​Speaker Topics**

![](https://images.lumacdn.com/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,dpr=2,anim=false,background=white,quality=75,width=800/editor-images/8g/839cff71-9058-4a4c-9805-79d873678be5.png)

## **TBD**

​Topics and speakers are in-development. Stay tuned!

​​If you're interested in giving a talk please submit a request on [our website.](https://devx.network/?utm_source=luma)

# **​​​Commuting**

## **​​​Suggested Car Parking**

*   ​​​Street ($0)
*   ​​​[San Diego County Waterfront Garage](https://maps.app.goo.gl/sT8BXxgKDcJKjQt2A?utm_source=luma) ($20)
*   ​​​[Fashion Valley Mall](https://maps.app.goo.gl/P9ovewu3u6XicwnG7?utm_source=luma) ($5)
    *   ​​​take the green line from `Fashion Valley Transit Center` to `County Center/Little Italy Station`
    *   ​​​costs `$2.50` each way

## **​​​Suggested Bike Parking**

*   ​​​[Waterfront Park](http://\(https//maps.app.goo.gl/53cb8AWX3cepfsXu8\)?utm_source=luma)

## **​​​Suggested Rails**

*   ​​​[Green and Blue Trolly Lines](https://www.sdmts.com/transit-services/trolley?utm_source=luma)
    *   ​​​stop at [County Center/Little Italy Station](https://maps.app.goo.gl/aum84xGfsFhF2RGa9?utm_source=luma)
*   ​​​[Coaster](https://gonctd.com/wp-content/uploads/COASTER-Schedule-October-2024-Web.pdf?utm_source=luma)
    *   ​​​stop at [Santa Fe Depot](https://maps.app.goo.gl/vtxdo1xSpREVUZoD9?utm_source=luma)

# **​​Live Stream**

​​We'll be streaming the event live on YouTube for those who cannot attend in-person. [Click here to view the scheduled live stream](https://youtube.com/live/J0vc9F2_JYs?feature=share&utm_source=luma).

# **​​Our Community**

​​You can find more information about our community at [devx.network](https://devx.network).

​​Also, join our Discord community to ask what others are interested in learning in the #event-talk channel: [https://discord.gg/hyf9KSaKtv](https://discord.gg/hyf9KSaKtv)

​​If you're interested in giving a talk please submit a request on [our website.](https://devx.network/?utm_source=luma)

# **​What to Expect**

​​Join us for a special weekend developer experience! We're long time San Diego developers, looking to fostering a community of devs of all skill levels to have fun, network, and learn new things!

## **​​Connect**

​​​For this monthly meetup, we gather for lunch to introduce ourselves and enjoy complimentary food and drinks.

## **​​Inspire**

​​After networking lunch, we start a series of presentations from members of the community to share interesting developer topics.

## **​​Build**

​​​Once presentations are finished, we break into groups to casually network, show off our projects and build together!

# **​​Reminders**

​​Please be courteous and respectful to others.

​​​Laptops are encouraged. Should you be giving a presentation or want to share a project, your laptop is essential. We are developers, let’s build together

​​​Feel free to ask our organizers for help on some code you're struggling with, if you are! We're happy to help where we can.

Three years in, has AI delivered us the freedom? - Cammie Clay and Sonia Sarao
Our company is Freedom With AI LLC. We founded it mid-2023 when we saw the potential of AI changing every aspect of our personal and work lives. We left the corporate world and went all in. Three years in, has AI delivered us that freedom? Yes and No.

We started with AI content, thought about Advisory services, decided to build an inside-out product for early-stage entrepreneurs and recently landed on all three, feeding each other. 

From playing with every early new AI tool - chatgpt, dall-e, midjourney, etc. - to deciding every week which Claude or GPT model is better for which part of the product workflow, from using AI to help us do our own hosting on a VPS to yelling at it for tunneling on user questions, from having to spend hours doing manual research to using Obsidian and Cursor as naturally as a quick conversation, from having a huge paycheck just talking about AI to starting from $0 building with AI - it has been a rollercoaster and that’s what we will share with you. You may not learn what to do, but we certainly hope you will learn what NOT to do as you start your entrepreneurial journey, even if it’s just on the side.

Claude Code for Designers - Tryston Perry
Claude can't spit out an image the way Nano Banana or GPT can — no pixels, no diffusion. But that limit is where the real creativity starts: point Claude at the right tools and it writes the code that draws, renders, and ships real visuals.

## Three years in, has AI delivered us the freedom? - Cammie Clay and Sonia Sarao

Our company is Freedom With AI LLC. We founded it mid-2023 when we saw the potential of AI changing every aspect of our personal and work lives. We left the corporate world and went all in. Three years in, has AI delivered us that freedom? Yes and No.  
  
We started with AI content, thought about Advisory services, decided to build an inside-out product for early-stage entrepreneurs and recently landed on all three, feeding each other.  
  
From playing with every early new AI tool - chatgpt, dall-e, midjourney, etc. - to deciding every week which Claude or GPT model is better for which part of the product workflow, from using AI to help us do our own hosting on a VPS to yelling at it for tunneling on user questions, from having to spend hours doing manual research to using Obsidian and Cursor as naturally as a quick conversation, from having a huge paycheck just talking about AI to starting from $0 building with AI - it has been a rollercoaster and that’s what we will share with you. You may not learn what to do, but we certainly hope you will learn what NOT to do as you start your entrepreneurial journey, even if it’s just on the side.

![](https://images.lumacdn.com/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,dpr=2,anim=false,background=white,quality=75,width=800/uploads/gj/dbac60a2-1af0-4ede-96f5-4fe3d87731ce.jpg)

## Claude Code for Designers - Tryston Perry

Claude can't spit out an image the way Nano Banana or GPT can — no pixels, no diffusion. But that limit is where the real creativity starts: point Claude at the right tools and it writes the code that draws, renders, and ships real visuals.

Join us in a special weekend developer experience! We're long time San Diego developers, looking to foster a community of devs of all skill levels to have fun, network, and learn new things!

# **What to Expect**

For this monthly meetup, we gather for lunch to introduce ourselves and enjoy complimentary food and drinks. After, we start a series of presentations from members of the community to share interesting developer and engineering topics.

Once presentations are finished, we break into groups to casually network, show off our projects and make exciting new friends.

Feel free to ask our organizers for help on some code you're struggling with, if you are! We're happy to help (if it's in C, you're on your own tho lol).

Please be courteous and respectful to others.

# **What to Bring**

Should you be giving a presentation or want to share a project, bring your 💻 laptop! We want to see what you're excited about. Whether it's an app you're building, a new library you found, or what you learned last week about useEffect().

# **Food**

We have complimentary 🍕pizza and 🍺🥤beverages. Please help yourself!

# **Agenda**

12:00: Networking Lunch

12:30: Speaker Presentations

1:30: Networking / Sessions

4:00 Closing

# **Speaker Topics**

## _Ink Native Svelte_  
– AJ Caldwell

AJ will show how to build native apps for the ReMarkable (an E-Ink tablet) using Svelte 5 and rmkit.

## _How To Survive AI as an Engineer_  
– Ade Fadey

Ade Fadey will discuss the fundamentals of AI and introduce practical tools for Front and Back End engineers. He will demonstrate how these AI tools can enhance workflow efficiency and increase engineers' value to their organizations.

## _How to fix the internet by building Chrome extensions_  
– Ezekiel Lopez

Learn how to build web browser extensions for Chrome and other compatible browser.

_P.S. Want to give a talk? Reach out to us on Discord/Meetup or at the event._
